verdict.rationale: MX documents a dedicated capability to "Get the available balance for an end user's financial accounts," so a balance-retrieval feature exists. However, the evidence never says it is a real-time, on-demand call made before a payment, or that it is meant for NSF or risk checks. The only freshness detail covers aggregation, which runs roughly every 24 hours. missing for 10: explicit real-time/on-demand balance refresh semantics, documentation positioning the endpoint for NSF/pre-payment risk checks, endpoint-level reference details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
